script: She said you're too old. Listen carefully. She didn't reject you. She rejected a man who apologizes for his age. At twenty-five, you had energy. At forty-five, you have standards, stories, and a spine. Stop explaining your age. Stop joking about it first. Say it once, calmly, and move on. The right woman isn't looking for young. She's looking for steady. Be steady. If a no still stings, I put a short guide together. Comment REJECT, and I'll send it over.
